messages:
Priya Shah: Quick heads-up — Delta Orbit go-live next Tue. Need final confirmation on dedicated pool quota and autoscale windows. Who can own the load-test and warmup plan?
Mateo Flores: I can run the load tests Friday. target profile is 1200 concurrent requests, 30k tokens/min burst for 2 hours.
Erin Kline: Thanks Mateo. What's the initial reserved quota we're committing? customer asked for 8 GPUs but ops suggested starting at 6 with autoscale to 10.
Alex Morgan: Ops recommended 6g (p4d equiv) as committed, with burst cap to 10g. We should set soft limits so they don't blow past budget.
Jordan Li: Can we set autoscaler to scale at 70% utilization with 2-min cool down? that'll avoid flapping during ramp.
Mateo Flores: 70% sounds right. For the warmup run I plan: 1) priming (100 reqs/min, 30m) 2) ramp (10 -> 1200 conc over 45m) 3) sustained soak (2h) 4) failure scenarios (node kill, model fallback).
Priya Shah: Solid. Can you paste the exact vegeta script or k6 job you'll run so eng-sre can reproduce? Also need results format for the health review doc.
Mateo Flores: Pasting quick vegeta snippet: ```echo "GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=200 -duration=45m -connections=1200 | tee results.bin | vegeta report -type=text > report.txt```
Alex Morgan: Add header with API key + model param in the request. Also include a second stream for long-context chats (seq len 4k) to validate memory/KV cache behavior.
Erin Kline: Reminder: Delta Orbit requires private networking for PII flows; warmup must run in their VPC peering cluster. Ops: do we have staging pool in that VPC?
Jordan Li: Yes — staging vpc-peak has a 4g pool. We need to provision temporary extra 2g there for the ramp. I'll file the quota request now.
Priya Shah: Filing note: customer success SLA asks for <150ms median token latency at 95th pct for standard prompts. Can we meet that at the committed size?
Alex Morgan: At 6g we should be ~120ms median for short prompts on the test model. Long-context will be higher. We'll include latency breakdown per token in the report.
Mateo Flores: Running a dry-run tomorrow at low scale (10m) to validate tooling. ETA for full run: Friday 09:00 PT. Adding ops checklist: provision burst nodes, confirm KMS access, seed KV cache with common prefixes, turn on per-route tracing.
Priya Shah: Who's oncall for Friday in case the load triggers alarms?
Jordan Li: I'll be primary, Erin backup. capacity-bot will post autoscale events in the channel.
capacity-bot: Autoscaler scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-27 08:00-09:00 UTC. No scaling actions will be taken during maintenance.
Erin Kline: Noted — avoid running the main soak during that window. Move to 09:00 PT?
Mateo Flores: 09:00 PT works. I'll update the runbook and upload results to this doc: https://docs.redwood.example/delta-orbit/warmup-results (shared with eng-sre & ops).
Priya Shah: Also capture the enablement checklist: runbook walk-through with their platform engineers, API key rotation guidance, and escalation path (pager + CSM). We need sign-off post-run for renewal timeline.
Alex Morgan: On the technical side, I'll add a fallback model routing policy so if the dedicated pool hits soft cap we route low-priority traffic to hosted endpoint. Config snippet: ```routing: - match: priority: low fallback: hosted-3b```
Jordan Li: Ops will enable the soft cap at 90% of reserved quota and set alert at 85%. That gives 5% buffer before fallback.
Priya Shah: Perfect. After the soak, please capture: peak concurrent, sustained token/sec, autoscale events (timestamps), any OOMs/errors, and latency percentiles. We'll review morning after and compute risk to renewal.
Mateo Flores: Will do. I'll ping when results are uploaded.
Erin Kline: Quick ask — can we also include a cost delta estimate for keeping 8g vs 6g committed? Customer asked for guidance.
Alex Morgan: I'll run cost model post-run and add to the summary.
Priya Shah: Thanks all. Action items: Mateo run loadtest Fri 09:00 PT; Jordan provision + oncall; Alex fallback config + cost delta; Erin enablement checklist; Priya coordinate sign-off. :thumbsup:
Mateo Flores: Copy — prepping artifacts now.
Jordan Li: Quota request filed: Q-54219. Will update once nodes are available.
capacity-bot: Quota Q-54219 status: APPROVED. Nodes available in staging-vpc in 18 minutes.
Priya Shah: Awesome — we'll reconvene here if anything changes. End of thread.
